packet.title: IR passes after : item demands and child walks (implementation)

body.p: After (item demands), and . Validating one EN 16931 invoice with sxml validate --schematron costs 1.61 x 10^9 instructions, 87 % of it compiling the .sch; the IR passes are 31 %, led by sxml_ir_set_item_demands (12.4 % inclusive, 4.2 % self) and push_every_child (6.5 % self), with children_of and make_owners behind them (src/ir.c, src/ir_loop_passes.c).

item.p: Mechanism: profile first (callgrind on that run, the pre-compiled invoice run and perf-12's growth series); find why item demands and the child walks cost what they do (repeated whole-unit walks, walks per function or per pass that could share one) and make them proportional to the unit once; the IR text form after the passes stays identical.
Owns: src/ir.c, src/ir_loop_passes.c, src/ir_global_read.c, src/ir_internal.h and src/ir_pass_internal.h (their pass parts), tests/ir_test.c, tests/ir_loop_passes_test.c, tests/bench/.

Done when: before and after (instructions and seconds) in a D-record on both invoice runs, the growth series, xmark-all and the XT40 compile; IR text identical on EN 16931 and the XT40 units; QT4 XP40, XQ40 and XT40 whole, base and change in the same setup: no outcome changes, case by case; Schematron 463 of 463, VEFA 1,133. Done 2026-10-28 (): the passes walked the unit about ten times at about 130 instructions per expression; the child walk writes in place, the demand pass walks each body once, the descendant census and fusion's choice of functions come from owners. Invoice validate 1.613 to 1.413 x 10^9, transform 1.618 to 1.506; IR text and demands identical (EN 16931, growth, 414,470 XT40 units); XP40, XQ40, XT40 0 outcomes differ; suite 463/463, VEFA 1,133/1,133.
